roadmap.title: Risk Remediation
roadmap.description: Address the 1 HIGH-severity risk(s) identified in the risk register before any Agent 2 executor output goes live.

recommended_ai_agents.name: CookieYes
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Automated cookie consent management platform powering over 1.5 million websites. Handles GDPR, CCPA, and Google Consent Mode v2. Auto-blocks scripts before consent. Maintains a clean consent log. Free tier available for small sites.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Free tier available. Pro plans from £10/month per domain

recommended_ai_agents.name: Termly
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Automated compliance platform generating GDPR-compliant privacy policies, cookie policies, and terms of service. Scans website for compliance gaps. Embeds compliance widgets directly on site. Best for businesses that need legal documents without hiring a solicitor.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Free plan available with watermark. Paid from £14/month

roadmap.title: Activate Built Executor Outputs
roadmap.description: Go live with the 1 opportunity(ies) Agent 2 has already built and connected.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Lyro by Tidio
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: AI agent for Shopify stores that handles order status, returns, and product questions. Critically for adoption risk, Lyro trains on your existing FAQ and knowledge base in under 10 minutes and improves from human agent responses — meaning staff see it as a tool that learns from them rather than replacing them. Smart escalation to human agents when needed.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Gorgias AI Agent (human-in-the-loop mode)
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Gorgias's 2026 update introduced configurable human oversight controls — the AI drafts responses and flags them for human review before sending for defined categories (size advice, refund decisions, complaints). This is the practical implementation of hallucination risk mitigation for a fashion SME's customer service stack.

roadmap.title: Deploy Remaining Executable Opportunities
roadmap.description: Build out the remaining 3 executable opportunity(ies) survivors identified by Agent 2.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Loop Returns
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges. When a customer initiates a return, Loop suggests alternative products, different sizes, or store credit. Directly reduces refund leakage for fashion brands with high size-related return rates. Provides structured returns data as a byproduct.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Not a single tool but a strategy: running primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list ensures no single marketing automation vendor holds all customer communication. Both export subscriber lists in standard CSV — satisfying Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 portability requirements.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts

roadmap.title: Future Opportunities (Deferred)
roadmap.description: 4 opportunity(ies) remain deferred until prerequisite pillar scores improve.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Iubenda (AI processing disclosure)
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Iubenda's AI processing disclosure templates specifically cover the UK AI Bill 2026 transparency requirements — informing customers when AI is used in decisions affecting them. For fashion SMEs deploying sizing or recommendation AI, this is the lowest-cost path to meeting transparency obligations.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Prediko
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: AI-powered inventory forecasting for Shopify brands. Provides accurate stock predictions, automated purchase order recommendations, real-time restock alerts, and inventory reports. Reduces overstock and stockout through data-driven buying decisions.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Paid plans from approximately £30-£100/month depending on SKU count
